name: Voice Subtitles
description: Live subtitles for Simple Voice Chat. Shows who is speaking and what they say, taking the roleplay name straight from the player list. Built so that deaf and hard-of-hearing players can follow proximity voice chat, and so that anyone playing without sound can too. Recognition is offline and client-side: no audio ever leaves your machine and nothing is uploaded anywhere. The mod itself is 3 MB; on first use it downloads a recognition engine (sherpa-onnx or Vosk) and a language model for the language you play in, checking the engine against a built-in hash before loading it. Both can be turned off and installed by hand instead. Keeps a searchable conversation log on your own disk. Thanks to Contik for testing.
